allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep 10; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4000/health" -TimeoutSec 5; $r.Content } catch { "Backend nie odpowiada: $_" })

PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($proc\) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Output "Zabito PID $\($proc.OwningProcess\)" } else { Write-Output "Port 4000 wolny" })
